{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Velvet blazer cut, long line, vibrant red #E63946, wool blend.
Wide-leg trousers cut, ankle length, deep charcoal #2F3A3F, heavy cotton twill.
Round-toe ballet flats, flat heel, classic black #1C1C1C, soft calfskin leather.
Gold hoop earrings and a delicate pendant necklace in 14k gold finish.

This outfit works because it balances your desire for a bold red top with the relaxed autumn evening vibe you want to share with friends. The velvet texture of the blazer adds a touch of refined luxury that elevates casual wide-leg trousers into a cohesive smart-casual ensemble perfect for a fall day. By pairing these pieces with classic black flats and subtle gold jewelry, the look remains comfortable for all-day wear while ensuring your wish for a red upper garment becomes the undeniable focal point of the outfit."}
